title: Chapitre 24 : Durée (Depuis + Présent)
description: Exprimer depuis combien de temps on fait quelque chose.

sentences.french: Je suis ici depuis une heure.
sentences.english: I have been here for an hour.
You have been working since the morning.

sentences.french: Il habite à Paris depuis deux ans.
sentences.english: He has been living in Paris for two years.

sentences.french: Nous étudions le français depuis trois mois.
sentences.english: We have been studying French for three months.
You have been waiting for a long time.
They have been sleeping since noon.
Since when have you been living here?

depuis.mnemonic: Think 'de-piss' — I've been doing this since I had to go to the bathroom.
depuis.explanation: Used with the present tense in French to describe actions that started in the past and are still ongoing.
